knowledge_gaps: Suffix augmentation also reweights supervision toward later positions: for a history of length n, position j survives with probability 0.5 + 0.5j/n. Its benefit could reflect target weighting rather than removal of stale context. Add a matched loss-mask control that retains full context.

The baseline receptive field is unspecified. Removing history outside that field cannot affect a prediction. Report effective context lengths and how often augmentation removes accessible context; clarify that full-history inference remains bounded by the receptive field.

Negative sampling needs an explicit user-ID mapping, efficient exclusion procedure, and fallback when fewer than eight eligible items exist. The diagnostic loader's leading None cannot provide user identity. Filtering all training positives also excludes items occurring after an intermediate training target; document this choice and its effect on sampling.

Global averaging over surviving positions and averaging within each row produce different training weights. Specify reduction, zero-valid-target handling, padding masks throughout convolution blocks, and B×L×8 scoring without changing the diagnostic interface.

Four configurations require sixteen category-model fits. Concrete trial allocations, stopping rules, tie handling, and diagnostic reserves are missing. Report paired category-level validation differences where supported; acknowledge validation selection bias and uncertainty from only 200 users per category.

Originality 4 is reasonable, but potential 7 is speculative and difficulty 4 may underestimate efficient sampling and masking. Verify the NextItNet citation title and add directly relevant cropping-augmentation references before asserting novelty.
